mapper.sql: t.id, t.project_id, t.code, t.title, t.phase, t.priority, t.status, t.precondition, t.steps, t.expected_result, t.actual_result, t.assignee_id, t.created_at, a.name AS assignee_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM test_case t LEFT JOIN account a ON a.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY t.code
SELECT FROM test_case t LEFT JOIN account a ON a.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_case (project_id, code, title, phase, priority, status, precondition, steps, expected_result, actual_result, assignee_id) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{code}, #{title}, #{phase}, #{priority}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending'), #{precondition}, #{steps}, #{expectedResult}, #{actualResult}, #{assigneeId})
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case SET status = #{status}, actual_result = #{actualResult} WHERE id = #{id}
